about_the_game:
My Place Diary is a casual simulation game where you decorate your dream space with pixel graphics. If you want to turn an ordinary space into your own special hideout, jump into the game right now!

Check out the features of the game with the demo version.

How to Play The My Place Diary demo version has one mode: Themed Stage: This is a mission mode where you decorate a room to a specific concept. Decorate spaces with various themes! The full version will have more stages and a free-play mode!

The Unique Experience of Decorating Your Own Space Placing items is very simple. Just click the number key of the item you want in your inventory, then click on the space with your mouse to place it. If you want to change the item's direction, click on it and press the Q or R keys to rotate it by 15 degrees. Once all items are placed, you can choose to continue decorating the space or move on to the next stage through the "Stage Clear" screen.

Unleash your creativity and complete a unique, wonderful space that is one-of-a-kind in My Place Diary!
